beats.headline: The sixth hand on the cookbook
beats.text: Subject carried the cookbook in its sixth edition and added to it. Her note on portals admits what nobody else will: there are dozens of kinds, they do not behave consistently, and one the size of a button can throw you into a monster den.

beats.headline: The stew
beats.text: Subject used to make a stew for her whole family: rance meat, bone broth, and a wild grass from the leeward side of their island, prayed over while it simmered. Prepared properly, it quickened the route of the yearly migration in the minds of the young. The aliens took her before she could make this year's, and her youngest are not in here with her. Her note asks who will show them the way.

beats.headline: The hidden door opens
beats.text: Subject, guildmaster of the hidden calligraphy and cartography guilds in Club Vanquisher, has not had a one-on-one with a floor supervisor in over fifty seasons, and wrote a scroll long ago that mutes the announcements. Woken by a fight in the hall, she finds her door open for the first time in a very long while: a vampire, her caprid son and his hellspawn pet. The pet burns her. The vampire heals her. Milk hopes aloud that they will not threaten her, as she might then be forced to give them a map of the secret exits.

beats.headline: The guildmaster in the hidden guild
beats.text: Prepotente pushes a wall panel, and Crawler Carl and friends discover two hidden guilds, the Map-Making Guild and the Calligrapher's Guild. "Again?" asks the guildmaster, half frog and half bat. Her name hovers over her head. Milk. Author of the sixth edition of the Cookbook, who wrote at length about the wings of the Xenopus and the Vesper. She had no idea who Crawler Carl was until that moment, and then she did. She wrapped him in leathery wings and told him to let it out, and he did, while the others looked on, bewildered.

beats.headline: Kidnapped, on advice
beats.text: Guildmaster Milk declined every invitation to leave Club Vanquisher with Crawler Carl, and the system would not let him hire her. Rosetta's advice was blunt: kidnap her. Tie her up and take her. Kidnapping and "torturing" guildmasters for their information is not merely allowed but encouraged. She cannot be kept in a saferoom, so she is being held in the FUPA, where Prepotente, Rosetta and Mordecai are "interrogating" the prisoner. Katia wants very badly to ask about Carl throwing himself into her arms, and is smart enough not to.

beats.headline: Stayfast ink, and a pen
beats.text: Milk tells Carl she once wrote her recipes in a book, then switched to a different ink to share them with a wider group, and everything written after the switch faded away. Some of her best recipes were gone when they were needed most, and she calls that her fault. Rosetta grunts. Then Milk hands him Stayfast Ink, 825 ml, which nothing will ever make fade, and an Adept's fountain pen, and reminds them that anything Carl writes in the Book of Voodoo goes to everybody who already has it. Then she jumps from the tower and glides away.

beats.headline: One final meal
beats.text: Milk will not go to the twelfth floor. She goes back to her guild. She has fulfilled her contract, lives out the season, and may leave after it, glad to have been given the chance to cook one final meal. Then, amplified by a word etched on her own throat, she presents the crawlers taking deals and the former crawlers going home: each crawler has painted three skills or spells onto pages, one for Carl, one for Donut, one for anyone. Goodbye, Carl. Burn it all to the ground. He hugs his sister.
